transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hey Dr. Smith. Well, I guess I came in because... man, I just feel like I got this motor running inside me all day long, you know? Like, if I have to sit still for more than a minute, whether it's at home, or out in your clinic waiting room just now, or at church... oh, man, church is the worst. Pastor Dave just goes on and on. Last Sunday he was talking about Noah's Ark, which is wild if you really think about it. Like, how did they keep the lions from eating the zebras? I was watching this YouTube video about lions the other day. My buddy Mike sent it to me. He works over at the tire shop on 4th street. They got a really good deal on winter tires right now, if you need any for your car. 

But yeah, if I'm sitting there in the pew, I just feel totally trapped. I have to get up or do something. I can't take it. I usually end up walking around the back or trying to fix something. Like the hinges on their double doors were squeaking real bad, so I went out to my truck to get my tools. You ever use that dry silicone spray instead of regular WD-40? I'm telling you, it doesn't attract dirt as much. I use it on everything now.
Have you felt this way your entire life, or is this something that started more recently?

Oh, definitely my whole life. It ain't new at all. Like, back when I was a boy in school, my teachers were always moving my seat. I mean constantly. Because I just could not stay put, you know? I was always talking out of turn, and I'd get in big trouble for jumping up before class was even done. I just couldn't wait for that bell. 

Especially in Mrs. Gable's room... she had this huge mole on her chin, right? And every time she talked, it just bobbed up and down. Me and Tommy used to count how many times it moved. Tommy was my best friend back then. He actually got a dirt bike that year, a little Honda. Man, we rode that thing all over the trails behind the old quarry until the chain snapped on us. We tried to fix it with some baling wire, which, let me tell you, do *not* ever try that on a motorcycle. It whipped around and almost took my leg off. You ever ride dirt bikes, Doc? I haven't been on one in years, but I was looking at some on Craigslist last night... people want crazy money for them now, even the beat-up ones.
